verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair privacy-posture question for an identity-verification service that stores end-user biometric and document data, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a deletion endpoint, configurable retention periods, or purge controls. The closest items are session management in the Customer Portal and PDF export, which are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
